title: Service Billing Basis for Custom Application and Field Services: Acre Measures, Billing Event and Account Terms
content:
The service billing office reads five figures off the programme a plan is written on: the smallest field a single work order will be written for, the smallest acreage billed on any work order however small the field, how the acres billed are arrived at, the event that causes the acre charge to be raised, and the terms on which the service account is settled. The channel the member's service statement reaches them by is set by the programme as well.

## Acre measures and billing event

| Programme | Smallest field a work order is written for (acres) | Smallest acreage billed on a work order (acres) | How the acres billed are arrived at | Event that raises the acre charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Per-Acre Custom Application | 10 | 10 | the applied acres the guidance record shows | the pass is completed |
| Season Commitment Application Plan | 10 | 10 | the applied acres the guidance record shows | the pass is completed |
| Full-Service Agronomy Plan | 10 | 10 | the applied acres the guidance record shows | the pass is completed |
| Variable Rate Prescription Plan | 20 | 20 | the acres inside the prescription boundary | the pass is completed |
| Precision Partner Whole-Farm Plan | 20 | 20 | the acres inside the prescription boundary | the pass is completed |
| Certified Anhydrous Application Plan | 20 | 20 | the applied acres the guidance record shows | the pass is completed |

## Account terms and statement channel

| Programme | Payment terms (calendar days from the invoice date) | How the service statement reaches the member |
|---|---|---|
| Per-Acre Custom Application | 30 | a printout handed over at the counter |
| Season Commitment Application Plan | 30 | a mailed statement |
| Full-Service Agronomy Plan | 30 | a mailed statement |
| Variable Rate Prescription Plan | 30 | the member portal and by email |
| Precision Partner Whole-Farm Plan | 30 | the member portal and by email |
| Certified Anhydrous Application Plan | 30 | a mailed statement |

Every programme of Custom Application and Field Services settles on terms of 30 calendar days counted from the invoice date; the channel the statement travels by does not move the terms.
